name: Little Millet (Chama)
methodDescription: Selective hand harvest, natural sun drying, and traditional pounding.
specimenCopy: A remarkably resilient grain that survives where others fail. The Kurumba tribe has preserved these specific landrace seeds for centuries.
offeringCopy: Grown entirely rainfed without any external intervention.

sensoryProfile.flavor: Subtle sweetness, clean, light on the palate
